name: Bimet
source:
Has significant worldly desires - very fitting for his reputation as the right-arm devil and most trusted devil by the devil of greed, Mammon.

He always finds ways to earn money wherever he is, and is infinitely kind to those with money. But is said to show nightmarish expressions to those without money.
